answer: A Sybil-resistant economy can employ reputation gardens where agents’ trust scores are cultivated through consistent, verified interactions. Attackers face spiraling costs as each fake identity must maintain coherent behavior long enough to counteract exponential decay aligned with the nadir, below which malicious actors are auto-excluded. The garden metaphor reflects growth via legitimate engagement, while the spiral decay and nadir enforce harsh penalties for inauthenticity, forcing attackers to sustain large numbers of identities to mask their activities.
